properties.name: Union St, 12th St to Third St and the Western Pacific near First St

sources.note: "authorized to construct a line of railroad along Union Street, crossing Twelfth, Tenth, Eighth, Seventh, and Fifth Streets and across Third, Union and Magnolia Streets".
"placed in operation in April of 1957", from the WP near First and Magnolia Sts to the Key System's tracks at Twelfth and Union Sts.

properties.notes: Opened in April 1957 (CPUC); The Western Railroader has it opening on March 1, 1957, with a gold spike.
properties.geometry_method: Along today's Union Street centerline from 12th Street to 3rd Street (812 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1, across gaps of up to 150 m where the street is cut today); then joined to wp-mole at its end; checked on USGS Oakland West 1:24,000 (1949). Along Union St from the Key System's 12th St line to Third St (CPUC Decision 53801); then, over the Western Pacific's property, to its line near First and Magnolia Sts, drawn straight to the end of the WP's mole track at Chestnut Junction, about 270 m: no source places that stretch.
